product_metadata.title: Emerald Wholesale Solid Berber Carpet Runner Rug/Mat, 22 by 60", Brown
features: Non-Skid backing keeps this runner rug in place, perfect for those high traffic areas like kitchens, hallways, garage, shops, etc
Durable olefin Berber carpet construction ensures a long life of looking fresh and clean
Naturally stain resistant fibers, keeping this mat looking clean
Available in multiple colors: blue brown, burgundy, tan
description: This quality, made in the USA, runner rug is the perfect addition to any high traffic area in your home. Use it in the kitchen, hallway, living room, around your couch, or even in your garage, workshop, etc. This olefin runner pairs excellent quality and durability with a fashionable looks and construction. Non-Skid / non-slip rubber backing keeps this mat in place and looking good. Measures 22in wide and 60in long. Machine washable.

Emerald Wholesale is a direct importer and manufacturer of home textiles with distribution to both brick and mortar retailers and e-commerce channels in North America.  From facilities in Dalton, Ga, Emerald fully manufacturers product as Made in the USA and finishes raw imported goods.  Our products span the home decor market, ranging from area rugs, corner rugs, hearth rugs, stair treads, rug runners, scatter rugs, bamboo mats, decor pillows, travel pillows, bed pillows, indoor cushions, outdoor cushions, outdoor pillows, blanket protector bags, comforter protector bags, and many other home decor textiles.  With a goal to bring on the best value to the marketplace, you are sure to find great deals, competitive pricing, and quality product from Emerald Wholesale.
